title: Flat fee at disbursement: 15,000.00 MNT charged in full on the disbursement row.
_note: Closes the corpus's blindness to a NON-ZERO fee: the loanschedule corpus carries only 0.00 fees/penalties, so a Go port that mishandled charges would still pass it. This vector transcribes the observed flat fee (feeChargesDue 15000 on the disbursement row, totalFeeChargesCharged 15000.00) of a FLAT charge (calculation_type 1, charge_time_enum 1). A flat charge's fee is its flat amount; no arithmetic is performed, so no base amount is required.

provenance.note: TRANSCRIBED, never computed, from the T40 capture FC-01. The expect cell fee_minor 1500000 is the exact major->minor scaling of the observed 15000.00 (feeChargesDue 15000 on the disbursement row; totalFeeChargesCharged 15000.00).
